operational_dataset_integrity.immature_handling: TBM immature plantings have zero yield by design and are excluded from mature yield modeling.

boron_ppm_integrity.handling: Missing Boron values are strictly preserved as NaN / JSON null and are never silently converted to 0. Available nutrient count dynamically decrements from 6 to 5 without skewing the ratio.

soil_chemical_survey_validation.unsampled_handling: Soil data is strictly reported as observed field measurements for the 7 sampled blocks and marked Unavailable for the remaining 35 blocks. No blind imputation or synthetic soil fabrication is permitted.

weather_evidence_policy.spatial_discrimination: ZERO (identical station averages repeated for all 42 blocks)
weather_evidence_policy.reporting_status: Reported as estate-level meteorological context only.

rgb_drone_module.benchmark_origin: MOPAD Site 2 (Malaysian Oil Palm Aerial Dataset)
rgb_drone_module.justification: Research benchmark imagery lacks GIS block boundary shapefiles, GPS ground control points, and temporal alignment with operational harvest records.

multispectral_uav_module.label: Technical Benchmark / Demonstration Only – German Beech Forest Dataset
multispectral_uav_module.justification: Dataset was flown over a German temperate deciduous forest; zero geographical or botanical overlap with the tropical oil palm estate.
